title: Protocol for a Non-randomized Survey in Down Syndrome People Who Practice Sports. Self and Observers´ Perception.
brief_summary: This survey arises from one objective of a PhD thesis whose purpose is to "Identify what social skills people with Down syndrome have that do a routine activity and compare them with those developed by those SD people who perform sports activities."
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Down syndrome
* Do sport
* Belonging to Cordoba, Mágala and Granada Associatio

Exclusion Criteria:

* Others metal incapacities
* Others Asociation
study_population: Down Syndrome people who practise sports and a people who know them well (at least for six months) and who have the opportunity to observe person evaluated for extended periods of time (parents, family, tutors, teachers etc.).
